name: Kahti
description: A feral Gruul child who steals a melon, then Ossett's coin purse for the conspiracy.

timeline.summary: In the Gruul market, Ossett catches a child thieving but pays the merchant and lets her go.
timeline.quote: I sigh, then let the child go.

timeline.summary: Baas Solvar is freed. Ossett waits for Brazer at the market, and Kahti steals her coin purse while hugging her.
timeline.quote: Then I notice my coin purse is gone.

pages_say.description: A feral Gruul child who steals a melon, then Ossett's coin purse for the conspiracy.
